svg.title: Isolated workloads share storage
svg.desc: Draw separately bounded workload lanes ending at one shared cache. Keep clear gutters between workloads; the topology must remain legible if every label is covered. Use the independent shared package-cache namespace geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.
